sentences.en: She'll be seeing to your correspondence while Miss Cobb's away.
sentences.zh: 科布小姐不在的时候，她会处理你的信件。

sentences.en: This pair of lovers were carrying on an ardent correspondence.
sentences.zh: 这对恋人之间进行着热烈的通信。

sentences.en: She was able to continue her education through correspondence courses.
sentences.zh: 她通过函授课程继续接受教育。

senses.zh: 通信，信件往来；一致性，相似性，对应关系；函件，信函
